item.title: How Fighter Pilots Use “Post-Stall Maneuvering” in Air Combat
item.description: “Post-stall maneuvering” gives a plane excellent maneuverability—but the equipment needed to boost it comes with tradeoffs, as all advanced aircraft features do. The post How Fighter Pilots Use “Post-Stall Maneuvering” in Air Combat appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: No, Russia Isn’t Planning to Invade Europe in 2029
item.description: There is little evidence that Russia seeks a broader conquest of Europe after the Ukraine War, even as many hawkish European defense officials warn of one. The post No, Russia Isn’t Planning to Invade Europe in 2029 appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Tap, Click, Kill: AI-Powered FPV Drones in the Ukraine War
item.description: As electronic jamming disrupts the connection between FPV military drones and their pilots, they will increasingly rely on artificial intelligence to make independent targeting decisions. The post Tap, Click, Kill: AI-Powered FPV Drones in the Ukraine War appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Why Russian Iskander-M Missiles Are Raining Down on Odesa
item.description: Russia has made no secret that it hopes to conquer the port of Odesa from Ukraine—and has used advanced missiles and drones to soften the city’s defenses. The post Why Russian Iskander-M Missiles Are Raining Down on Odesa appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Venezuela’s “Obsolete” S-125 Pechora-2M Might Embarrass US Stealth Planes
item.description: Venezuela’s S-125 anti-air missile system is positively ancient today—yet the same model was unexpectedly able to shoot down an F-117 Nighthawk over Serbia in 1999. The post Venezuela’s “Obsolete” S-125 Pechora-2M Might Embarrass US Stealth Planes appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: The Arleigh Burke Flight III Upgrades: Too Little, Too Late?
item.description: The new destroyer is a badly needed addition to the US Navy’s surface fleet—and shows that America’s ailing shipyards can occasionally produce good results. The post The Arleigh Burke Flight III Upgrades: Too Little, Too Late? appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: The Israel-Iran Missile Game Could Drag America Back into War
item.description: In anticipation of another conflict, Israel has urged the United States to support an invasion of Iran to overthrow the Islamic Republic. President Trump should demur. The post The Israel-Iran Missile Game Could Drag America Back into War appeared first on The National Interest.
